_about: Pilot-six CRY SYNTH parameter blocks (DRAFT status). Each block is the 'synth' object of the species sheet's cry block (see species-sheet-schema-patch-cry.md). Identities follow SHOW-BIBLE S4: Mochii bouncing squeak-cry; Dorowani low steady croak; Gabu foghorn bellow; Kittember thin mewl; Sproutle soft chirps; Wispkin whisper-wail. pitch_env / amp_env are [normalised_time, value] keyframes; pitch values are semitone offsets from base_hz. Render with tools/cry_synth.py.

dorowani.identity_note: Low steady croak — unhurried, patient, told-you-so. Two slow throat pulses from a pulse-width-modulated low voice.

gabu.identity_note: Foghorn bellow — total confidence, no plan. A big low horn that swells in, holds, and drifts down; slight breath at the edges.

kittember.identity_note: Thin mewl with a warm crackle underneath — a small cat voice, rising then falling away, with faint fire-pops from the tail flame woven through it.

mochii.identity_note: Bouncing squeak-cry — a squeaky metronome: three bright hops, pitch bouncing up-down-up, joyful and round.

sproutle.identity_note: Soft chirps — three gentle, rounded chirps with quiet gaps between them; a noticer's small voice, never startling.

wispkin.identity_note: Whisper-wail — soft and breathy, a slow minor fall carried on noise-breath; the night keeper heard more than seen.
